requirements_path.description: Absolute path to the validated requirements.json.

evidence_status.description: 'retrieved' if evidence was fetched this invocation; 'validated' if pre-existing evidence passed validation.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw Jira response bytes, as recorded in requirements.json.

analysis_path.description: Absolute path to the requirements-analysis.json, or null if absent.

analysis_status.description: State of the requirements analysis artefact: 'absent' (not yet produced), 'stale' (SHA-256 mismatch), 'invalid' (corrupt or structurally invalid), 'reused' (valid and current).

required_next_action.description: 'run_analysis' if the skill must execute Stages 1-3; 'none' if existing analysis can be returned directly.
